fato_historico: 2000: Expedition 1 arrived at the International Space Station for the first long-duration stay onboard. From this day to present, a continuous human presence in space on the station remains uninterrupted.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to expand your perspective, much like the historic first steps taken toward permanent residency among the distant stars. Today, consider how you might establish a lasting home for your dreams. It is a good time to pursue new knowledge and perhaps explore uncharted mental territories that hold a promise of infinite growth and discovery.
frase_do_dia: Your spirit is a traveler charting paths across the vast cosmos of possibility.
significado_numero: Represents the mastery of building dreams into a concrete, lasting reality.
conselho: Keep your eyes on the stars while planting your feet firmly on the ground.
